tools.name: AI Chat
tools.description: Ask questions, explore ideas, and talk with an AI that runs on your device.
tools.placeholder: Ask a question or describe what you need help with…

tools.name: Writing Assistant
tools.description: Turn a topic or brief into a first draft, right in this workspace.
tools.prompt: Write a clear draft based on this brief.
tools.placeholder: Describe your topic, audience, and what you want to write…

tools.name: Paraphraser
tools.description: Rewrite your own text with fresh wording while keeping its meaning.
tools.prompt: Rewrite the following text. Keep the original facts and meaning.
tools.placeholder: Paste the text you want to rewrite…

tools.name: Email Writer
tools.description: Draft an email from your purpose, key points, and preferred tone.
tools.prompt: Write an email using the information below. Do not invent facts.
tools.placeholder: Who is the email for? What should it say?…

tools.name: Social Caption Writer
tools.description: Create caption ideas for a post, product, or upcoming announcement.
tools.prompt: Write three short social media captions using this brief.
tools.placeholder: Describe the post, product, and your audience…

tools.name: Product Description
tools.description: Draft product copy from the features and details you provide.
tools.prompt: Write a concise product description. Only use the supplied features.
tools.placeholder: Product name, features, materials, and who it is for…

tools.name: Video Script Writer
tools.description: Get a short script with a hook, key points, and a call to action.
tools.prompt: Write a short video script with a hook, main points, and a call to action.
tools.placeholder: Describe the topic, video length, audience, and goal…

tools.name: Idea Brainstormer
tools.description: Explore a handful of useful directions for your next project.
tools.prompt: Give five distinct ideas for this brief, with one sentence explaining each.
tools.placeholder: Tell me about your project and the ideas you need…

tools.name: Code Helper
tools.description: Ask for code explanations and small coding examples.
tools.prompt: Help with this coding question. Explain your reasoning and note uncertainty.
tools.placeholder: Paste a small code example or explain what you want to build…

tools.name: Task Planner
tools.description: Break a goal into smaller, practical steps you can work through.
tools.prompt: Break this goal into a practical numbered list of small steps.
tools.placeholder: Describe your goal, constraints, and deadline…

tools.name: Text Summarizer
tools.description: Get a shorter version of an article, notes, or a passage of text.
tools.placeholder: Paste an English article or passage to summarize…

tools.name: Text Translator
tools.description: Translate English text into French, Spanish, or German.
tools.placeholder: Enter English text to translate…

tools.name: Sentiment Analyzer
tools.description: See whether English text sounds positive or negative, with a model score.
tools.placeholder: Paste a review, message, or short piece of English text…

tools.name: Ask Your Text
tools.description: Find a short answer to a question inside a passage you provide.
tools.placeholder: Paste the English passage containing the answer…

tools.name: Entity Finder
tools.description: Find people, organizations, locations, and other named entities in English text.
tools.placeholder: Paste the English text you want to analyze…

tools.name: Portrait Background Remover
tools.description: Create a transparent PNG cutout of a person in a photo.
tools.note: Designed for photos of people. It may not work well on products or other objects.

tools.name: Image to Text
tools.description: Extract written text from an image using local OCR.
tools.note: Clear, straight text works best. Handwriting and decorative type may be inaccurate.

tools.name: Image Captioner
tools.description: Generate a short description of what is visible in a picture.
tools.note: The model can miss details or describe objects incorrectly. Check its output.

tools.name: Image Classifier
tools.description: Get the most likely image labels and their model scores.
tools.note: Uses ImageNet categories. Results are model estimates, not verified identifications.

tools.name: Object Detector
tools.description: Find common objects and draw labeled boxes on an image.
tools.note: Recognizes a fixed set of common object types. Small or unusual objects may be missed.

tools.name: Image Depth Map
tools.description: Create a grayscale estimate of the relative depth in your image.
tools.note: Relative depth only. This is not a measurement of real-world distances.

tools.name: Audio Transcriber
tools.description: Turn a short audio recording into text without uploading it to a service.
tools.note: Audio up to 2 minutes. Accuracy varies with language, recording quality, and background noise.

tools.name: Subtitle Generator
tools.description: Create timed SRT subtitles from a short audio recording or video soundtrack.
tools.note: Audio up to 2 minutes. For a video, upload its audio track. Check timings and text before publishing.

tools.name: Text to Speech
tools.description: Generate an English voice recording and download it as a WAV file.
tools.placeholder: Type a short English passage to turn into speech…
tools.note: Uses one synthetic English voice. It does not clone voices.

tools.name: AI Photo Editor
tools.description: Enhance, retouch, and apply cinematic AI-style filters and lighting adjustments to photos for free in your browser.
tools.note: Processes 100% on your device via client-side canvas. No file size or privacy limits.

tools.name: AI Logo Designer
tools.description: Design free professional vector logos, modern brand emblems, and geometric marks with instant SVG & PNG export.
tools.placeholder: Enter your brand name (e.g. Apex AI, Lumina, Harbor)…
tools.note: Generates 4 distinct vector SVG concepts with dark & light mockups. Download SVG or high-res PNG for free.

tools.name: AI Prompt Generator
tools.description: Generate masterfully engineered prompts for Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, ChatGPT, and Claude with customizable styles and parameters.
tools.placeholder: Describe your idea or subject (e.g. a futuristic cyberpunk street market in Tokyo during rain)…
tools.note: Creates master prompts, parameter flags, negative prompt tokens, and creative variations with 1-click copy.

tools.name: Grammar Fixer
tools.description: Correct spelling, grammar, and punctuation in a short passage.
tools.prompt: Correct the spelling, grammar, and punctuation. Return the corrected text and preserve its meaning.
tools.example: We was planning to launch on monday, but the design need a few changes.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Tone Rewriter
tools.description: Change how a message sounds while keeping its key facts.
tools.prompt: Rewrite the supplied message in the requested tone. Preserve all facts and requests.
tools.example: Please send the missing photos today so we can finish the project.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Text Simplifier
tools.description: Make complicated wording easier to read and understand.
tools.prompt: Rewrite this in simple everyday English with short sentences. Preserve the meaning.
tools.example: The implementation of the new procedure will facilitate improved collaboration between departments.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Text Expander
tools.description: Develop short notes into a fuller paragraph using your details.
tools.prompt: Expand these notes into one clear paragraph. Use only the supplied information.
tools.example: Community garden: opens Saturday, free entry, bring seeds, volunteers welcome.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Text Shortener
tools.description: Trim a paragraph while preserving its main information.
tools.prompt: Shorten this text by about half. Keep the essential facts. Return only the shorter version.
tools.example: Our community center will open a new reading room next month. Visitors can use it from Monday to Saturday. It will include comfortable seating, donated books, and a quiet corner for studying.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Blog Outline
tools.description: Organize a topic into a compact article structure.
tools.prompt: Create a brief blog outline with a title and five headings. Use the supplied topic and audience.
tools.example: A beginner guide to caring for indoor plants in a small apartment.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Blog Introduction
tools.description: Draft an opening paragraph from your article brief.
tools.prompt: Write an engaging blog introduction of fewer than 100 words. Do not invent statistics or sources.
tools.example: An article for beginners about learning photography with a phone.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Headline Generator
tools.description: Try five different headlines for your article or announcement.
tools.prompt: Suggest five clear, distinct headlines using only these details.
tools.example: A neighborhood library is starting a free Saturday reading club for children.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: SEO Title Writer
tools.description: Draft concise page titles from your topic and target phrase.
tools.prompt: Write three page title options under 60 characters. Include the supplied target phrase naturally. Do not promise search rankings.
tools.example: Page: beginner indoor plant care. Target phrase: indoor plant care.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Meta Description
tools.description: Create a short search-result description for a page.
tools.prompt: Write two meta description options, each under 155 characters, based only on this page brief.
tools.example: A free guide with watering, light, and potting tips for beginner indoor plant owners.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Ad Copy Writer
tools.description: Draft a short advertisement using your offer and product facts.
tools.prompt: Write three short ad copy options with a headline and a call to action. Use only supplied claims.
tools.example: Handmade notebooks with recycled paper. Available in blue and green. Order online.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Slogan Generator
tools.description: Explore memorable lines for your brand or project.
tools.prompt: Suggest five short slogan ideas. Do not claim they are unique or trademark cleared.
tools.example: A neighborhood bakery that makes fresh bread each morning.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Brand Name Ideas
tools.description: Brainstorm names based on your business idea and personality.
tools.prompt: Suggest five brand name ideas and briefly explain each. Do not claim domain or trademark availability.
tools.example: A cozy handmade candle brand inspired by gardens and rainy evenings.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Content Calendar Ideas
tools.description: Sketch a week of content from your audience and goal.
tools.prompt: Create a seven-day content plan with one short post idea for each day. Base it on this brief.
tools.example: An independent stationery store wants to show new notebooks, packaging, and creative journaling ideas.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Audience Persona Draft
tools.description: Turn an audience brief into a useful draft customer profile.
tools.prompt: Draft a hypothetical customer persona from the supplied brief. Clearly label assumptions. Include needs and possible objections.
tools.example: A reusable lunch box for office workers who bring meals from home.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Social Bio Writer
tools.description: Write a short profile bio for your brand or personal page.
tools.prompt: Write three short social profile bios using only the supplied details.
tools.example: A freelance photographer specializing in family portraits in Lahore. Bookings open.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Hashtag Ideas
tools.description: Suggest topic-relevant hashtags for your post.
tools.prompt: Suggest ten relevant hashtags. Do not claim they are trending or guarantee reach.
tools.example: A short video showing hand stitching on a leather card holder.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Call to Action Writer
tools.description: Create short prompts that invite the next step.
tools.prompt: Suggest five concise calls to action matching this offer and goal.
tools.example: Invite visitors to download a free beginner photography checklist.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Concept Explainer
tools.description: Explain an idea with a simple example and clear language.
tools.prompt: Explain this concept simply with one example. If source notes are supplied, use them. Be honest about uncertainty.
tools.example: Explain why plants need sunlight, in language suitable for a beginner.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Study Notes
tools.description: Organize your source material into brief revision notes.
tools.prompt: Turn the supplied material into five short study points. Use only the source material.
tools.example: Plants use sunlight to convert water and carbon dioxide into sugars. This process is called photosynthesis. Chlorophyll absorbs light. Oxygen is released as a byproduct.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Flashcard Maker
tools.description: Create question-and-answer flashcards from your notes.
tools.prompt: Make four flashcards from these notes. Format each as Question and Answer. Use only the supplied facts.
tools.example: The Earth orbits the Sun in about 365 days. The Moon orbits the Earth. Gravity keeps objects in orbit.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…
tools.note: Creates question drafts for up to four source sentences or lines. Answers come directly from your notes. Tap a card to reveal its answer, and check that each question fits.

tools.name: Practice Quiz Writer
tools.description: Draft a short quiz and answer key from a source passage.
tools.prompt: Write three multiple-choice questions with an answer key from the supplied passage. Use only its facts.
tools.example: Water freezes at 0 degrees Celsius and boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure. Ice is solid water. Water vapor is a gas.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Lesson Plan Draft
tools.description: Plan a short lesson around your topic and learning goal.
tools.prompt: Create a short lesson plan with an objective, activity, and quick check of understanding.
tools.example: A 20-minute lesson teaching beginners how to identify a noun in a sentence.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Vocabulary Helper
tools.description: Explore word meanings and example sentences.
tools.prompt: Explain the supplied words in simple English and give one example sentence for each. Be honest if unsure.
tools.example: Explain: curious, reliable, and patient.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Analogy Maker
tools.description: Find an everyday analogy for a difficult concept.
tools.prompt: Explain the concept with one everyday analogy. State one way the analogy is imperfect.
tools.example: Explain computer memory to a beginner using an everyday analogy.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Study Plan
tools.description: Turn your study goal and available time into a practical schedule.
tools.prompt: Create a realistic short study plan based on the available time and goals.
tools.example: I have five days to review three biology chapters. I can study for one hour each day.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Debugging Helper
tools.description: Explore likely causes of an error in a small code snippet.
tools.prompt: Inspect this short code and error. Explain a likely cause and suggest a small fix. Do not claim the code was executed.
tools.example: JavaScript: const items = null; console.log(items.map(x => x.name)); Error: Cannot read properties of null.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Regex Helper
tools.description: Draft a regular expression and explain its parts.
tools.prompt: Suggest a simple regular expression for the request. Explain the pattern and give matching and non-matching examples. State that it needs testing.
tools.example: JavaScript regex to match a six-digit postal code made only of numbers.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: SQL Draft Helper
tools.description: Draft a small SQL query from a table description.
tools.prompt: Write a SQL query using only the supplied schema. Explain it briefly. Do not invent table or column names.
tools.example: Table orders has id, customer_id, total, created_at. Find total sales for each customer.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Test Case Ideas
tools.description: Think through useful cases for a small function or feature.
tools.prompt: Suggest five test cases for the described behavior, including edge cases and expected outcomes.
tools.example: A function accepts an age and returns true if it is 18 or older.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Code Comment Writer
tools.description: Add explanatory comments to a short code snippet.
tools.prompt: Add concise explanatory comments to this code. Preserve the code behavior and do not claim to run it.
tools.example: function doubleNumbers(numbers) { return numbers.map(n => n * 2); }
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: README Draft
tools.description: Create a compact project README from the facts you provide.
tools.prompt: Draft a short Markdown README with purpose, setup, and usage. Use only supplied facts and mark missing information.
tools.example: Project: Plant Notes. A static HTML page for tracking plant watering. Open index.html in a browser. No installation.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Meeting Notes Organizer
tools.description: Turn your meeting notes into decisions and next actions.
tools.prompt: Organize these notes into decisions and action items. Include owners and dates only when supplied.
tools.example: Team agreed to use green packaging. Sara will send a revised design on Friday. Ali will check the printing cost. Next review is Monday.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Resume Bullet Writer
tools.description: Rewrite your experience into clear resume bullet points.
tools.prompt: Write three concise resume bullets using only supplied experience and achievements. Do not invent metrics or qualifications.
tools.example: Worked in a bookstore. Helped customers find books, organized stock, and trained two new colleagues.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Cover Letter Draft
tools.description: Draft a brief cover letter from your experience and job details.
tools.prompt: Write a short cover letter from the supplied job and experience. Do not invent skills or employment history.
tools.example: Role: customer support assistant. Experience: two years helping customers at a bookstore and organizing stock.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Interview Practice Questions
tools.description: Prepare practice questions for a role you describe.
tools.prompt: Suggest five relevant interview practice questions and one tip for structuring answers.
tools.example: An entry-level graphic designer role focused on social media layouts.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Proposal Outline
tools.description: Structure a short project proposal from your brief.
tools.prompt: Create a proposal outline with scope, deliverables, timeline, and open questions. Do not invent prices or commitments.
tools.example: A client needs five product photos and a 20-second launch video. Work should finish within two weeks.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Story Starter
tools.description: Start a short fictional story from your setting and idea.
tools.prompt: Write an opening scene of fewer than 150 words based on this fictional premise.
tools.example: A librarian discovers a book that changes its last page every night.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Character Builder
tools.description: Sketch a fictional character with a goal and a conflict.
tools.prompt: Create a brief fictional character profile with personality, motivation, and one conflict.
tools.example: A young mechanic living in a floating city, who dreams of exploring the ground below.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Poem Writer
tools.description: Create a short original poem from a topic or mood.
tools.prompt: Write a short original poem of no more than eight lines using this topic and mood.
tools.example: A quiet garden after rain. A hopeful mood.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Lighthearted Joke Writer
tools.description: Try a few playful jokes about an everyday topic.
tools.prompt: Write three short, friendly, lighthearted jokes about this everyday topic.
tools.example: Indoor plants and forgetting to water them.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Prompt Builder
tools.description: Turn a rough request into a clearer AI instruction.
tools.prompt: Rewrite this request as a clear AI prompt with task, context, and output format. Do not invent missing facts.
tools.example: I want ideas for a short video about my handmade notebooks.
tools.placeholder: Add your text or brief here…

tools.name: Text Similarity
tools.description: Compare how closely two short passages match in meaning.
tools.placeholder: Enter the first English passage…
tools.note: Uses English sentence embeddings. Similarity is a cosine score, not a probability, fact check, or plagiarism verdict.
tools.example: A child is playing with a dog in the garden.
tools.secondaryExample: A young person and a puppy are having fun outdoors.

tools.name: Semantic Search
tools.description: Find the most relevant passage in your own list, even with different wording.
tools.placeholder: Put one short English passage on each line (2–20 lines)…
tools.note: Uses English sentence embeddings. Similarity is a cosine score, not a probability, fact check, or plagiarism verdict. Up to 20 passages of 700 characters each.
tools.example:
The cafe serves coffee and fresh bread.
The station has trains to the city every hour.
The library lends books and has a study room.
tools.queryExample: Where can I borrow something to read?

tools.name: Keyword Extractor
tools.description: Rank phrases from your text by how well they represent its meaning.
tools.placeholder: Paste a short English passage…
tools.note: Ranks phrases already in your text with sentence embeddings. Results are relevance estimates; names and unusual phrasing can be missed.
tools.example: Urban gardens provide fresh vegetables and green space. Community gardening brings neighbors together and teaches children about sustainable food.

tools.name: Similar Text Finder
tools.description: Find the closest matching pairs in a list of short passages.
tools.placeholder: Put one short English item on each line (2–20 lines)…
tools.note: Uses English sentence embeddings. Similarity is a cosine score, not a probability, fact check, or plagiarism verdict. Shows up to five closest pairs; similar wording does not establish copied work.
tools.example:
The cafe opens at eight in the morning.
Coffee is served from 8 AM at the cafe.
The library closes at six in the evening.

tools.name: Key Sentence Finder
tools.description: Pick representative sentences from a passage without rewriting them.
tools.placeholder: Paste an English passage with at least two sentences…
tools.note: Ranks up to 20 sentences using embedding similarity and returns up to three in their original order. It can miss important details.
tools.example: The library opened on Monday. It offers books, free computer access, and a quiet study room. Reading clubs run every Saturday. Residents can register for a free membership. The project was funded by local donations.

tools.name: Topic Classifier
tools.description: Estimate which everyday topic best fits a short passage.
tools.placeholder: Paste a short English passage to classify…
tools.note: Compares the fixed topic labels. Scores are model estimates, and a passage may not fit any label well.
tools.example: The new computer uses less energy and can run software more quickly.

tools.name: Custom Text Classifier
tools.description: Compare your text against topic labels that you choose.
tools.placeholder: Enter a short English passage…
tools.note: Choose 2–8 descriptive labels. Scores compare those labels; they do not verify facts or make reliable high-stakes decisions.
tools.example: The parcel arrived a day earlier than expected and was packed carefully.

tools.name: Missing Word Predictor
tools.description: Suggest words that could fit one blank in an English sentence.
tools.placeholder: Use [MASK] for one missing word, for example: The sky is [MASK].
tools.note: Use exactly one [MASK] placeholder. Predicts likely wording, not a verified answer.
tools.example: I drink a cup of [MASK] every morning.

tools.name: Custom Image Labels
tools.description: Compare a picture with descriptions you choose using CLIP.
tools.labelsExample: a cat, a dog, a bicycle, a landscape
tools.note: Choose 2–8 short descriptions. Scores compare the options and can be misleading if none describes the image.

tools.name: Sound Classifier
tools.description: Estimate common sounds in a short audio clip, such as music or barking.
tools.note: Audio up to 10 seconds. Uses AudioSet sound categories; it does not identify speakers or transcribe speech.

tools.name: Speech to English
tools.description: Translate speech in a short recording into English text.
tools.note: Audio up to 2 minutes. Whisper Tiny supports multilingual speech, but translation quality varies. The output language is English.

tools.name: Audio Summarizer
tools.description: Transcribe a short English recording, then summarize its content.
tools.note: English recordings up to 2 minutes. First downloads total about 327 MB. Review both the transcript and summary for errors.

tools.name: Scan Summarizer
tools.description: Extract English text from a scan or screenshot and summarize it.
tools.note: For clear printed English text. OCR runs first, followed by a text summary. Download is about 300 MB plus the runtime. Check the extracted text.

tools.name: Translate to English
tools.description: Translate French, Spanish, or German text into English.
tools.placeholder: Enter French, Spanish, or German text…
tools.note: Select the language of your input. Each language pair downloads its own model. Short, simple passages work best.
tools.example: Bonjour ! Je vous souhaite une bonne journée.

tools.name: Ad Hook Lab
tools.description: Draft different opening lines and matching visuals for a short ad.
tools.prompt: Create five distinct ad hooks. For each, give one opening line and one visual idea. Use only supplied product facts; do not invent results.
tools.example: A slim leather wallet with six card slots. Target: men who dislike bulky pockets.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: UGC Shot Script
tools.description: Turn a product brief into a spoken script and practical shot list.
tools.prompt: Draft a 25-second UGC script. Pair each spoken section with a filmable shot. Include hook, problem, demo, and CTA. Do not invent testimonials or claims.
tools.example: A reusable water bottle with a carry strap. Show filling it, packing it, and taking it on a walk.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: VSL Outline
tools.description: Structure a sales video around your offer, evidence, and next step.
tools.prompt: Draft a short video sales letter outline. Include hook, problem, supplied solution, supplied evidence, and CTA. Mark missing evidence instead of inventing it.
tools.example: A beginner photography course. Six lessons, phone camera exercises, and a free first lesson.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: Creative Brief
tools.description: Give a campaign a clear audience, message, deliverables, and direction.
tools.prompt: Organize these facts into a short creative brief: goal, audience, message, deliverables, constraints, and open questions. Do not fill missing facts with guesses.
tools.example: Launch a handmade notebook. Two Instagram posts and one 15-second reel. Warm colors, recycled paper.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: Storyboard Planner
tools.description: Plan the sequence, framing, and action for a short video.
tools.prompt: Create a concise text storyboard with scene number, framing, action, and on-screen text. This is a shot plan, not generated video.
tools.example: A 15-second leather craft teaser. Start with texture, then stitching, then a brand end card.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: B-roll Planner
tools.description: Find filmable supporting shots that fit your script and footage.
tools.prompt: Suggest eight practical supporting shots for this script. Explain which line each shot supports. Do not claim to create footage.
tools.example: A short video about preparing a small home office: clear the desk, position a light, organize cables.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: Sound Design Brief
tools.description: Plan music mood, transitions, and effects for your edit.
tools.prompt: Create a short sound design plan from this video brief. Suggest moods and types of effects, not copyrighted tracks or download links.
tools.example: A 20-second product reveal: quiet close-up, quick detail cuts, then a logo on white.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: Thumbnail Concept Brief
tools.description: Draft readable thumbnail headlines and visual arrangements.
tools.prompt: Suggest three thumbnail concepts. Each needs a headline under five words, a visual arrangement, and one focal point. Do not invent performance results.
tools.example: A video teaching beginners how to organize video footage before editing.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: YouTube Description
tools.description: Create a useful video description from your topic and supplied links.
tools.prompt: Write a YouTube description with a short introduction, key takeaways, and a CTA. Include only supplied links and facts. Do not invent timestamps.
tools.example: Video: three tips for better phone photography. Covers window light, simple backgrounds, and steady framing.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: Carousel Planner
tools.description: Turn one idea into a sequence of social slides.
tools.prompt: Create a six-slide carousel outline with a short heading and body for each slide, ending with a CTA. Use supplied facts only.
tools.example: Explain three details of a leather card holder: neat stitching, finished edges, and a compact size.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: Launch Checklist
tools.description: Organize a product launch into practical tasks and missing decisions.
tools.prompt: Create a launch checklist from this brief. Separate preparation, launch-day actions, and follow-up. Mark unknowns.
tools.example: Launch a small online dates shop next month. Product photos and packaging are ready. Delivery details still need checking.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: Ad Angle Explorer
tools.description: Explore different reasons your audience might care about an offer.
tools.prompt: Suggest five distinct ad angles. Each needs an audience need, a supplied product detail, and a possible hook. Do not invent claims or research.
tools.example: A compact desk lamp with adjustable brightness and a foldable arm, for small home desks.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: Client Reply Draft
tools.description: Draft a clear, respectful response to a client message.
tools.prompt: Draft a concise professional reply to this client message using only my supplied instructions. Do not promise deadlines or prices not provided.
tools.example: Client asks for an extra reel. My reply should ask for the brief and say I will confirm a timeline after reviewing it.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: Follow-up Email
tools.description: Write a polite follow-up with a specific next step.
tools.prompt: Write a short, friendly follow-up from these facts. Include one clear next step. Do not invent urgency or commitments.
tools.example: I sent a video draft three days ago. Ask the client for feedback so I can start the final revision.
tools.placeholder: Add your source text, facts, or project brief…

tools.name: Invoice Email
tools.description: Prepare an email explaining a supplied invoice and payment details.
tools.prompt: Draft a brief invoice email. Include invoice number, amount, due date, and payment method only if supplied. Do not invent financial details.
tools.example: Invoice 014 for three social videos. Total $180. Due October 20. Payment by bank transfer.

tools.name: Project Handover Notes

tools.name: Portfolio Bio

tools.name: Case Study Outline

tools.name: Bullets to Paragraph

gemini.name: Google Gemini
gemini.limits: Eligible models have free input and output. Request quotas depend on the model, region, and account; check AI Studio. A paid Gemini app subscription is separate.
gemini.after: Wait for quota reset or enable paid API billing for higher usage.
gemini.setup: Sign in to Google AI Studio and create a Gemini API key. Keep the project on Free tier for free API use.
gemini.caution: Free-tier content may be used by Google to improve its products. See the linked provider terms.

groq.name: Groq
groq.limits: GPT-OSS free defaults: 30 requests/minute and 1,000/day, with token limits. Whisper has separate audio quotas. Organization limits can vary.
groq.after: Wait for quota reset or upgrade to the paid Developer plan.
groq.setup: Create a Groq account and an API key in the console. Choose the Free plan.

mistral.name: Mistral AI
mistral.limits: Free mode has model-specific monthly quotas shown in your account. No payment card is required for Free mode.
mistral.after: Wait for the allowance to renew or switch to pay-as-you-go.
mistral.setup: Create a Mistral Studio account, select Free mode, and create an API key.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.limits: The free router selects eligible free models. Standard free limits: 50 requests/day and 20/minute; purchasing at least $10 in credits can raise the daily ceiling. Model availability varies.
openrouter.after: Wait for the daily reset, or purchase provider credits to qualify for higher limits. This module always uses the free router.
openrouter.setup: Create an OpenRouter account and API key. This workspace is locked to openrouter/free.

jina.name: Jina AI
jina.limits: Welcome tokens are shared across Jina APIs. Token consumption differs by model and task; this is not a monthly reset or a live balance.
jina.after: Purchase additional tokens in your Jina account when the allowance runs out.
jina.setup: Get a Jina API key from its dashboard. The welcome allowance belongs to your account.

cerebras.name: Cerebras
cerebras.limits: A valid payment method is required to receive the $5 promotional credit. For development and evaluation. Access pauses on expiry or exhaustion without a separate PayGo purchase.
cerebras.after: Separately buy PayGo credits to continue; activation does not automatically enroll you in paid usage.
cerebras.setup: Create a Cerebras account, activate the offer with a payment method, and create an API key.

stability.name: Stability AI
stability.limits: New eligible accounts get 25 API credits for testing. The getting-started guide specifies Google social signup. 1 credit is $0.01; each action has its own cost.
stability.after: Buy additional credits through the provider after the trial is used.
stability.setup: Create a Stability developer account and API key. Check your credited balance before generating.

elevenlabs.name: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.limits: Free-plan credits are shared across features; API requests use your account allowance. Free output has no commercial license. Commercial rights and higher limits require a paid plan.
elevenlabs.after: Wait for the monthly reset or upgrade the provider plan for more credits.
elevenlabs.setup: Create an ElevenLabs account and an API key with permission for the feature you want to use.
elevenlabs.caution: Free output is for personal use; a commercial license starts on a paid provider plan.

cartesia.name: Cartesia
cartesia.limits: Free-plan credits cover text to speech and transcription. The free tier is for personal, noncommercial use. Available voices and models depend on your account.
cartesia.after: Wait for the monthly reset or buy a paid plan with more credits and commercial rights.
cartesia.setup: Create a Cartesia account and API key. Use Load voices to choose a voice available to your account.
cartesia.caution: The free plan does not include commercial use rights.

deepgram.name: Deepgram
deepgram.limits: New eligible accounts receive $200 in API credit without a payment card. Transcription and voice generation draw from the same provider balance.
deepgram.after: Continue with the provider’s paid usage after the trial credit runs out.
deepgram.setup: Create a Deepgram account and an API key with usage permission.

assemblyai.name: AssemblyAI
assemblyai.limits: The free trial covers transcription and speech understanding; it does not cover the LLM Gateway. An insufficient balance stops new requests.
assemblyai.after: Add payment details and purchase provider credits to continue.
assemblyai.setup: Create an AssemblyAI account and copy the API key from your dashboard.

fireworks.name: Fireworks AI
fireworks.limits: Fireworks describes $1 in signup credit for new accounts. Its current API billing uses prepaid credits. Account eligibility and available models can change.
fireworks.after: Purchase more provider credits after the initial allowance is used.
fireworks.setup: Create a Fireworks account and an API key. Confirm the signup credit in your dashboard.
